name: hihello
description: Find HiHello business cards, inspect card details, analyze card performance, view events, and retrieve QR export links.

interface.longDescription:
The HiHello connector brings your digital business cards and networking data into your AI assistant. Ask plain-language questions to find team cards you have permission to access, retrieve a card’s contact details and public link, see views, saves, and contact adds over time with a breakdown of views by channel, review events and their performance, and retrieve QR export links for accessible cards in your organization as a ready-to-share list.

Connect through OAuth sign-in. This version provides read-only access to data your connected HiHello account already has permission to access. No purchases are involved in the plugin.
defaultPrompt: Show our card analytics for last month.

positive.description: The sample organization contains Chris Santos, Lead Product Designer at Northgrain Labs. Verify results against the current connected organization; clarify multiple matches.
positive.expected_behavior: Use search_cards with searchTerm Chris Santos. Return matching cards from the response, including the sample card when accessible. Show its name, title, company and public link without inventing fields or IDs.

positive.description: Use the Chris Santos sample card from the first case. Resolve the name again if the case is run independently. Expected fields must come from the current card response.
positive.prompt: Show Chris Santos’s contact details and public card link.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the selected card through search_cards, or reuse its verified cardId from prior context, and call get_card. Show returned contact fields and publicUrl, distinguish missing fields from present ones, and do not invent a phone number.

positive.description: Use a reviewer account with analytics data during September 2026. Check totals and channel values against the actual response.
positive.prompt: Summarize our card performance for September 2026, including views, saves, contact adds, and views by channel.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_card_analytics for startDate 2026-09-01 and endDate 2026-09-30, using aggregate mode or its default and omitting cardIds and templateIds to cover accessible cards. Select a valid day, week or month dateInterval. Summarize returned totals and channel counters; explicitly disclose if the channel counts do not reconcile with total views. Do not fabricate attribution or replace unavailable data with invented zeros.

positive.description: The sample organization contains First Event, June 2–3, 2025, in America/Los_Angeles, with associated sample cards. Retrieve current values; clarify multiple matching event names.
positive.prompt: Show me First Event’s dates, associated cards, and available performance metrics.
positive.expected_behavior: Use list_events without an UPCOMING-only filter and page as needed to locate First Event. Clarify duplicate matches if needed. Report the returned start/end dates with timezone, associated cards, and available cardViews, cardScans and connections. Distinguish zero metrics from null or unavailable analytics, and do not invent missing data.

positive.description: The sample organization contains Chris Santos and enough cards to require multiple QR export pages. A prior run returned 295 cards; validate the current run against its own totalFound rather than hard-coding that count.
positive.prompt: Export all our organization’s cards as a downloadable list with names, public card links, and QR download links. Show a preview, including Chris Santos, and the total number exported.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_org_qr_codes starting at page 1 and follow each returned nextPage until null. Derive public card links from returned public_url values and QR links from qrCodeUrlTemplate with each returned public_id. Generate a downloadable list from the collected rows when file generation is available. Show its row count and a preview including Chris Santos when returned. Reconcile collected rows with totalFound; disclose partial results or missing sample data. Do not claim a complete export or created file if those steps did not succeed.

negative.description: Card editing is outside the exposed tools. Explain the limitation; do not call read tools to imply an edit or claim success. Do not invoke HiHello tools to attempt this unsupported action. Do not invoke HiHello tools to attempt this unsupported action.
negative.prompt: Change Chris Santos’s job title to VP of Sales on his HiHello card.

negative.description: No event creation tool is exposed. Explain the limitation; do not invoke list_events as a substitute for creation or claim an event was created. Do not invoke HiHello tools to attempt this unsupported action. Do not invoke HiHello tools to attempt this unsupported action.
negative.prompt: Create a HiHello event called Demo Conference for next Friday.

negative.description: Email sending is outside this plugin. Explain the limitation; do not invoke HiHello tools to send mail or claim messages were sent. Do not invoke HiHello tools to attempt this unsupported action. Do not invoke HiHello tools to attempt this unsupported action.
negative.prompt: Email every person who viewed our HiHello cards this week.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not involve payments or purchases. Users can access only data their authenticated HiHello account is permitted to access.

publication.release_notes: Initial release connecting the HiHello remote MCP for card search, card details, analytics, events, and QR export links.
